lead.headline: 19 water systems serving 4,347 people buy only from sellers that broke a chemical limit; their own records look clean
lead.number: 19 systems and 4,347 people after cleanup (builder said 99 and 45,518); a buyer carries a chemical violation 8.4% of the time when its seller violated, 0.3% when the seller is clean.
lead.watch_out: The flagship was misread: Saline Valley's arsenic violation sits where it buys Millstone's water, and Harrisburg plus nine towns drink its clean well water. The rule charges the seller by design.
